Banditry: masked riders fan out from a Ngaru-Bon scrub-line and demand the strongbox by the count of three. They know your cargo manifest by name.

A Khazadari outpost offers hot tea and stale bread; the commander wants news from the southern road.

encounters.beat: Mangrove roots tangle the trail; crocodiles sun on mud-banks and the guide will not pole past them.
Plague-quarantine: an Irrah salt-flats outrider blocks the road with a red banner. No party crosses without a fortnight's wait at the cordon, or a forged seal of clean passage.

encounters.beat: Mangrove roots tangle the trail; crocodiles sun on mud-banks and the guide will not pole past them.
Plague-quarantine: an Irrah salt-flats outrider blocks the road with a red banner. No party crosses without a fortnight's wait at the cordon, or a forged seal of clean passage.

Plague-quarantine: an Irrah salt-flats outrider blocks the road with a red banner. No party crosses without a fortnight's wait at the cordon, or a forged seal of clean passage.

encounters.beat: Mangrove roots tangle the trail; crocodiles sun on mud-banks and the guide will not pole past them.
Plague-quarantine: an Irrah salt-flats outrider blocks the road with a red banner. No party crosses without a fortnight's wait at the cordon, or a forged seal of clean passage.

encounters.beat: Mangrove roots tangle the trail; crocodiles sun on mud-banks and the guide will not pole past them.
Plague-quarantine: an Irrah salt-flats outrider blocks the road with a red banner. No party crosses without a fortnight's wait at the cordon, or a forged seal of clean passage.
